Cross-host determinism does not hold.

CI (ubuntu-24.04/x86-64) built 2ef4fdad0bef5c9b0bb88c1c5c651fb3b905be0f00364b4e36adda0fdeb33a2c;
the macOS/arm64 host built e08db880837bb0d2a90e7d23528aeefc116423f3240e8fd09dac0ae45313cac6.
Same source, same pin, same SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH, same volume ID, same pinned Rust
channel. Both hosts are internally stable — two builds byte-identical on each.

So profile.toml's `deterministic_rebuilds = 2` is a same-host claim, and the
build is host-deterministic rather than reproducible. Checking the claim from
outside instead of reading `reproducible_pair_checked` back off the receipt is
what surfaced this; the receipt is true and says less than a reader assumes.

Recorded in docs/reproduction.md; architecture.md and roadmap.md corrected.
Narrowing it is not part of this pass.
